# Elite Artist Society

> Elite Artist Society (EAS) is a six month coaching program for independent music artists, run by UrmetzBeatz Coaching LLC in Georgia. Founded in 2024 by Anthony Urmetz, EAS has coached more than 100 artists on turning attention into owned fans and direct income through email lists, fan communities and direct to fan offers.

## About the Founder

Anthony Urmetz is the founder of Elite Artist Society. He has been a music producer since 2020, signed to a small label and worked sessions with artists like 7AM before he turned to marketing. He works with Kosh, Kennedy Ryon's manager, and teaches the same direct to fan systems Kennedy's team uses.
